- Reflected in **US1 scenario 6** (save-time attempt + fallback indicator) and **US10** (reworded story + scenarios).

**2. Search operators vs. literal words**
- **FR-015** now: `AND`, `OR`, `NOT` act as **boolean operators**; enclosing any of them in **quotation marks** (e.g. `"and"`) matches it as **ordinary literal text**.
- Reflected in **US2 scenarios 6–7**.

Everything else from round 2 is unchanged, and all specification-quality checklist items still pass.
